entries.text:
Sec. 140. (a) In General.--For fiscal year 2022, the obligational 
authority of the Library of Congress for the activities described in 
subsection (b) may not exceed $292,430,000.
    (b) Activities.--The activities referred to in subsection (a) are 
reimbursable and revolving fund activities that are funded from sources 
other than appropriations to the Library in appropriations Acts for the 
legislative branch.

ancestors: DIVISION J—MILITARY CONSTRUCTION, VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2022
entries.text:
Sec. 140.  None of the funds made available by this 
Act may be used to carry out the closure or realignment of the United 
States Naval Station, Guantanamo Bay, Cuba.

[[Page 136 STAT. 541]]

entries.heading: An additional $130,000 shall be made available to the
ancestors: DIVISION L—TRANSPORTATION, HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2022
entries.text:
Sec. 140.  An additional $130,000 shall be made available to the 
National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, out of the amount 
limited for section 402 of title 23, United States Code,

[[Page 136 STAT. 709]]

to pay for travel and related expenses for State management reviews and 
to pay for core competency development training and related expenses for 
highway safety staff.
